caption: The video captures a night fireworks display over a calm dark body of water, with a distant shoreline of scattered city lights, a single slender tower on the horizon, and faint angled searchlight beams on the left. Two dotted light clusters, a looped shape on the left and a broader shape on the right, hang in the upper sky in purple and green points, each mirrored below. Small orange points emerge along the lower edges of these clusters and multiply into a horizontal row of radial starbursts as the dotted outlines thin into faint purple arcs overhead. The orange bursts fade as a row of purple circular wheel patterns becomes dominant, and the water reflection turns predominantly purple. Above this row, gold-orange spherical bursts ignite near the left, center, and right and grow, expanding into large chrysanthemum-like spheres while the purple wheels persist beneath. The lower-half patterns remain mirror reflections of the sky, shifting color with each new bloom.
relations: Dotted clusters thin into arcs as emerging orange bursts multiply into a fading horizontal row.
Orange bursts fading allows a row of purple circular wheels to become dominant.
Gold-orange bursts expanding into large spheres persist above the row of purple wheels.
Water reflections mirror the sky's evolving shapes, shifting color as each new bloom emerges.
